```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(bayestestR)
library(emmeans)
library(rstan)
library(tidybayes)
library(knitr)
library(priorsense)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(here)
```

### Import saved imputed dfs

```{r import-data}
analytic_dfs <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
length(analytic_dfs)
sapply(analytic_dfs, nrow) %>% 
  unique()
str(analytic_dfs[[1]])
```

### Create folders

```{r folders}
dir.create(here("Main Models"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Set up hypothesis formulas and priors

```{r hypothesis-formulas-priors}
# Formulas
formula_h1 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s * adhd_status
                 + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status
                 + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h1_nointeract <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s + adhd_status
                            + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

# Specify priors
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", tag = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", tag = "intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma", tag = "sigma")
)
```

## 2. Run models

### H1 Model

```{r H1-model}
fit_h1 <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h1,
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h1, here("Main Models", "fit_h1.rds"))
```

### H1 Model output

```{r H1-output}
bayes_R2(fit_h1)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h1 <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h1,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h1 <- effect_h1 %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Results summary
effect_h1 %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)
```

### H1 Model diagnostics and PP checks

```{r H1-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")
cat("Rhat values close to 1 indicate convergence. ESS should ideally be > 400.\n\n")
as_draws_df(fit_h1) %>% summarise_draws(default_convergence_measures())

cat("\n=== R-hat & ESS for log posterior density ===\n")
draws <- as_draws_array(fit_h1)

chains_per_imp <- 4
n_imp          <- nchains(draws) / chains_per_imp
n_imp

lp_by_imp <- lapply(seq_len(n_imp), function(i) {
  chains_i <- ((i - 1) * chains_per_imp + 1):(i * chains_per_imp)
  subset_draws(draws, variable = "lp__", chain = chains_i) |>
    summarise_draws("rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") |>
    mutate(imputation = i)
}) |> bind_rows()

lp_by_imp
summary(lp_by_imp[, c("rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")])

cat("\n=== Divergent Transitions ===\n")
cat("Ideally 0. Large numbers indicate sampler problems.\n\n")
cat("Number of divergent transitions:", 
    sum(nuts_params(fit_h1)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_h1)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_h1, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_h1)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_h1, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
cat("Observed median (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated medians.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1, type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k ===\n")
loo_h1 <- loo(fit_h1)
pareto_k_table(loo_h1)
plot(loo_h1, label_points = TRUE)

# Prior sensitivity
cat("\n=== Power-Scaled Sensitivity Checks ===\n")
powerscale_sensitivity(fit_h1)
powerscale_plot_dens(fit_h1)
powerscale_sensitivity(fit_h1, prior_selection = "b")
powerscale_plot_dens(fit_h1, prior_selection = "b")
powerscale_sensitivity(fit_h1, prior_selection = "intercept")
powerscale_plot_dens(fit_h1, prior_selection = "intercept")
powerscale_sensitivity(fit_h1, prior_selection = "sigma")
powerscale_plot_dens(fit_h1, prior_selection = "sigma")
```

### H1 Model no interaction

```{r H1-model-no-interaction}
fit_h1_nointeract <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h1_nointeract,
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h1_nointeract, here("Main Models", "fit_h1_nointeract.rds"))
```

### H1 Model no interaction output

```{r H1-no-interact-output}
bayes_R2(fit_h1_nointeract)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h1_nointeract <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h1_nointeract,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h1_nointeract <- effect_h1_nointeract %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Results summary
effect_h1_nointeract %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)

# ADHD difference in raw outcome units
cat("=== ADHD difference in raw outcome units ===\n")

# Extract SD of the raw outcome from each imputed dataset, then average across imputations
sd_ers_raw <- map_dbl(analytic_dfs, ~ sd(.x$ers_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mean()

draws <- as_draws_df(fit_h1_nointeract)

raw_effects <- draws %>%
  transmute(
    adhd_raw_effect = b_adhd_statusY * sd_ers_raw
  )

hdi_adhd <- bayestestR::hdi(raw_effects$adhd_raw_effect, ci = 0.95)

tibble(
  adhd_raw_effect_mean  = mean(raw_effects$adhd_raw_effect),
  adhd_raw_effect_lower = hdi_adhd$CI_low,
  adhd_raw_effect_upper = hdi_adhd$CI_high
) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

### H2 Model interaction

```{r H2-interaction}
slopes_emm <- emtrends(fit_h2, ~ adhd_status, var = "pubertal_timing_s")

# Extract full posterior draws for pd/ROPE calculations
slopes_posterior <- gather_emmeans_draws(slopes_emm) %>%      
  rename(slope = .value)

# Summary table
results_table <- slopes_posterior %>%
  group_by(adhd_status) %>%
  summarise(
    slope_mean = mean(slope),
    lower_95 = bayestestR::hdi(slope, ci = .95)$CI_low,
    upper_95 = bayestestR::hdi(slope, ci = .95)$CI_high,
    pd = as.numeric(p_direction(slope)),
    rope_percent = rope(slope, range = c(-0.1, 0.1), ci = 1)$ROPE_Percentage * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_95 = paste0("[", round(lower_95, 2), ", ", round(upper_95, 2), "]"),
    slope_mean = round(slope_mean, 2),
    pd = paste0(round(pd * 100, 1), "%"),
    rope_percent = paste0(round(rope_percent, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  select(adhd_status, slope_mean, ci_95, pd, rope_percent)

cat("\n=== Simple slopes analysis ===\n")
kable(results_table,
      col.names = c("Group", "Slope (Mean)", "95% CI", "pd", "% in ROPE"),
      align = "c")


cat("\n=== Pubertal timing effect on emotional reactivity (raw) in non-ADHD group ===\n")

# Get pooled raw-scale SDs across all imputed datasets

sd_pt_per_df  <- sapply(analytic_dfs, function(df) sd(df$pubertal_timing, na.rm = TRUE))
sd_out_per_df <- sapply(analytic_dfs, function(df) sd(df$ers_total, na.rm = TRUE))

sd_pt_pooled  <- mean(sd_pt_per_df)
sd_out_pooled <- mean(sd_out_per_df)

# Conversion factor

conversion_factor <- sd_out_pooled / sd_pt_pooled

# Extract non-ADHD slope in standardised units

# Use slopes_posterior (raw draws)
nonADHD_draws <- slopes_posterior %>%
  filter(adhd_status == "N") %>%
  pull(slope)

# Convert draws to raw units

nonADHD_raw_draws <- nonADHD_draws * conversion_factor

hdi_raw <- bayestestR::hdi(nonADHD_raw_draws, ci = .95)

# Summary
raw_slope_summary <- tibble(
  slope_mean_raw = mean(nonADHD_raw_draws),
  lower_95_raw   = hdi_raw$CI_low,
  upper_95_raw   = hdi_raw$CI_high
)

raw_slope_summary
```

### H2 Model interaction graph

```{r H2-interaction-graph}
raw_data <- analytic_dfs[[1]]
raw_data$adhd_status <- factor(
  raw_data$adhd_status,
  levels = c("N", "Y"),
  labels = c("Non-ADHD", "ADHD")
)

ce <- conditional_effects(
  fit_h2,
  effects = "pubertal_timing_s:adhd_status",
  int_conditions = list(adhd_status = c("N", "Y"))
)

ce_data <- ce[[1]]
ce_data$adhd_status <- factor(
  ce_data$adhd_status,
  levels = c("N", "Y"),
  labels = c("Non-ADHD", "ADHD")
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Non-ADHD" = "#0072B2",
  "ADHD" = "orange"
)

group_shapes <- c(
  "Non-ADHD" = 16,
  "ADHD" = 17
)

group_linetypes <- c(
  "Non-ADHD" = "solid",
  "ADHD" = "dashed"
)

x_lab <- "Pubertal Timing"
y_lab <- "Emotional Reactivity"

# Create plot
p <- ggplot(
  ce_data,
  aes(
    x = pubertal_timing_s,
    y = estimate__,
    color = adhd_status,
    fill = adhd_status,
    linetype = adhd_status
  )
) +
  
  # 95% credible intervals
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    alpha = 0.20,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Model-estimated lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  
  # Raw data
  geom_point(
    data = raw_data,
    aes(
      x = pubertal_timing_s,
      y = ers_total_s,
      color = adhd_status,
      shape = adhd_status
    ),
    alpha = 0.30,
    size = 2.0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(values = group_linetypes) +
  
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-3.0, 3.0),
    ylim = c(-3.0, 3.0),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      x_lab,
      "\n",
      "\u2190 Later                      Earlier \u2192"
    ),
    y = y_lab
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = element_text(lineheight = 1.4),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 10,
      b = 25,
      l = 45
    ),
    plot.title = element_blank()
  )
print(p)

ggsave(
  here("Main Models", "pubertal_timing_adhd_plot.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 900
)
```
